items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: Tedesco is the Tony Mottola of the west coast.

ctx.x: It was actually tough music to play and the woodwinds are going [scats].
Yeah, yeah, yeah. Tedesco is the Tony Mottola of the west coast.
I see. Wow. You know you’ve done a lot of interviews. In fact this is our third one. Is there ever a question that nobody asks that you’d like to talk about.
